relationships.subject: tear β-endorphin
relationships.evidence_quote: It showed a strong negative correlation with pain symptom score (r = −0.813, P < 0.001)

relationships.subject: tear CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP demonstrated a strong negative correlation with OSDI (r = −0.697, P < 0.001), indicating that lower CGRP levels are associated with more severe disease.

relationships.subject: tear MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: MMP-9 showed the strongest positive correlation with OSDI among all six mediators (r = 0.907, P < 0.001)

relationships.subject: tear MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: Microneuroma count demonstrated significant positive correlation with IL-6 (r = 0.285, P = 0.027), SP (r = 0.294, P = 0.004), MMP-9 (r = 0.376, P < 0.001)

key_findings: Tear CGRP correlated negatively with OSDI and corneal fluorescein staining in 101 dry eye patients, whereas MMP-9, NGF and SP correlated positively with OSDI.
Tear β-endorphin was uniquely associated with less ocular pain, longer corneal nerves and fewer microneuromas.
